query: What goal-management practices support high achievement?

per_column.name: goal_domain
per_column.rationale: Captures WHAT the goal is about (subject area), not a facet of the practices/factors that make goal management successful. It classifies goal content, an external descriptor, not an aspect of success factors.

per_column.name: improvement_mechanism
per_column.rationale: Describes the substantive lever used to achieve the goal's outcome (market expansion, cost control). This is content/means of the goal itself, not a constitutive aspect of goal-management practice quality.

per_column.name: quantitative_target_specificity
per_column.rationale: Target specificity is a genuine aspect of good goal-management practice (how precisely the target is quantified), a part-of the success-factor concept.

per_column.name: timeline_specificity
per_column.rationale: Time-bound clarity is a constitutive facet of well-managed goals (the 'time-bound' aspect of goal quality).

per_column.name: implementation_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope of implementation is a structural aspect of how the goal is managed, plausibly a facet of goal-management characteristics.

per_column.name: baseline_reference_specified
per_column.rationale: Whether a baseline is specified is an aspect of measurement rigor in goal setting; a facet. However it overlaps heavily with quantitative_target_specificity's 'percentage_with_baseline' value.

per_column.name: technology_enablement
per_column.rationale: Whether technology enables the goal is an external means/support, not an intrinsic aspect of the goal-management practice's quality.

per_column.name: employee_engagement_lever
per_column.rationale: Whether the goal uses an employee-engagement lever describes the mechanism/content driving outcomes, overlapping with improvement_mechanism and goal_domain, not a facet of success factors.

per_column.name: stakeholder_coordination_requirement
per_column.rationale: Coordination requirement is a genuine facet of goal management (ownership/collaboration structure), though it overlaps with implementation_scope (both carry 'customer_facing', cross-functional vs cross-departmental).

judge.rationale: Several columns are not constitutive facets of goal-management success factors but rather describe the goal's content or external enablers (goal_domain, improvement_mechanism, technology_enablement, employee_engagement_lever), failing the meronymy test. Among the genuine facets, there is substantial overlap: baseline_reference_specified duplicates an aspect already captured in quantitative_target_specificity, and stakeholder_coordination_requirement overlaps with implementation_scope (both encode organizational reach and 'customer_facing'), lowering mutual exclusivity. The facet subset does touch key aspects of goal quality (specificity, timing, scope, measurement, coordination) but misses others (e.g., accountability/ownership clarity, feedback/progress-tracking cadence, prioritization/alignment), and it is diluted by non-facet columns, so exhaustiveness is moderate at best.
